explanation: Count the required multiplicity of each equal-length word. For every possible starting offset, scan exactly the required number of blocks and reject an unknown or overused word. Return offsets whose entire block multiset matches.
timeComplexity: O(nkw) expected time for text length n, k words and word length w, including substring copying and hashing.
spaceComplexity: O(kw) dictionary and current-block count/key space, plus output.
